title: A "polyhedral coffee simulator" answers "needs to be a game", and gains a real mug
summary: Under the polyhedra video of Tue 17 Nov (see made-polyhedra-instruments-sakura), @norvid-studies.bsky.social replied at 18:10Z "sort of needs to be a game now". At 19:24Z, 74 minutes later, @dave.9000ish.uk (880 followers) replied "best i can do / polyhedral coffee simulator" with a link to polycoffee.9000ish.uk, whose page title is "Morning Coffee Simulator — Polyhedra Sakura". It is a new version of an earlier "Morning Coffee Simulator — Procedural Forest" by the same maker, who posted the next morning that the learnings had been applied back to "the previous model". A night setting followed on Wed 18 Nov at 06:58Z. At 12:59Z @samantha.wiki posted a photo with "Coincidentally, my mug this morning has polyhedra on it"; nine minutes later the maker replied with a link ending "?mug=wolfram" and "let's blur the lines between reality and simulation even further". Two more mugs followed as quote posts. One, from @shimmermathlabs.com, was a pink mug with a "crudely drawn polyhedron of 20 sides" (alt text), then a second image with a "nicer" one; @oszillate.bsky.social (75 followers) replied that there were squares in the back and that it was therefore a different solid, a sphenomegacorona, and the mug's owner replied "i want my money back!".

made.what: polyhedral coffee simulator ("Morning Coffee Simulator — Polyhedra Sakura")
the earlier simulator it derives from ("Morning Coffee Simulator — Procedural Forest")

couldBeShown: Research has not seen the simulator: no post describes its screen. What the posts establish: it is about having a morning coffee in a polyhedra-and-sakura scene taken from the video; it has a night setting ("?time=night"); a mug can be chosen by a link parameter ("?mug=wolfram"), added after a member posted a real mug; one member calls it "very peaceful"; another implies it can be used in a headset ("If I wasn't still on the Steam Frame waiting list I'd be drinking coffee in Polyhedra Sakura right now..."). The mug images: one has no alt text; the two pink-mug images are described by their alt texts.
numbers: 74 minutes from "sort of needs to be a game now" (18:10Z) to the simulator (19:24Z).
9 minutes from the mug photo (12:59Z) to the mug appearing as an option in the simulator (13:08Z).
A polyhedron "of 20 sides" on the pink mug (alt text).
20 likes and 4 reposts on the simulator post; 37 likes on the first mug post; 27 on the pink mug.
